question: What complete charged construction-plus-query and separate query counts does half-GCD produce on the same instances as classical Euclid/Newton and batched lookup, for coset and certified rational membership?

claims.text: Successful complete ordered relation sets match scalar subtraction and separate native wide replay.
Descriptive paired cold arithmetic and query counts; no time, exponent, fastest or whole-DLP inference.

arms.description: Exact repeat of half-GCD; count determinism control.
Batched subtraction including necessary descriptor/base build.
Identical lookup under unused half-GCD query flag.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Input-level conditioned sums must return nonempty complete sets on every arm; separate literal Euclidean matrix/gcd tests exercise recursive half-GCD. Query counters record actual half-GCD activation; no substitute speed-positive arm.

null_population.description: Matched batched lookup with an unused half-GCD flag.
null_population.generator: Same native next_compare v1 fixtures/targets/binary/stage limits.
null_population.why_n: One unaffected-path comparison per retained target; descriptive exact-count invariance, no distributional inference.

factors.name: representation_field_and_m
factors.how: Keep configurations separate. Rational fixtures are Mobius conjugates of squaring, not auxiliary-isogeny search benchmarks. Word62 has no prime-order subgroup assertion; P224 standard curve.

factors.name: target_population
factors.how: Alternating inputs, same exact target across all arms; identity separate.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One immutable native release binary, locked dependencies, one CPU.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.value: cyclic offset per target, reversed on odd target index
factors.how: Five arms interleaved with cyclic offset, reversed on odd input index.

factors.name: host_environment
factors.how: Unmodified isolated_bench CPU4; missing PSI/unmovable host threads mean below-L2 clocks.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Raw per-input values/ranges retained; no statistical significance test.

factors.name: construction_backend
factors.value: KaratsubaNewton for all descriptor/certification work; query backend only is changed for C-half
factors.how: Each arm freshly builds its descriptor. Lookup additionally builds its required point table/hash set; candidates build no unused table for finite targets. Counter phases remain separate.

seed_derivation.note: next_compare.rs v1: fixture0x686763642d7631 XOR m; root0x48470000+input index. Same exact inputs across arms. Rational representative3 and certificate seed42 fixed.

instance_sampling.rule: [['coset', 'word62', 8192], ['coset', 'word62', 16384], ['coset', 'p224', 2048], ['rational', 'word62', 2048], ['rational', 'p224', 128], ['rational', 'p224', 512]]; 0 excluded warmups then 2 retained, alternating uniform-x-rational and constructed sums. No uniform-point claim; identity separated.

blinding.how: Explicitly unblinded deterministic descriptive counts; no inferential selection.

power.note: Descriptive exact per-target observations, medians/ranges; not powered for population significance or exponent claims.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Bootstrap calibration itself, no calls yet:900s is its enforced conservative outer envelope, NOT an observed runtime forecast. It measures every exact main size/arm; actual native per-class forecast will be inserted into the separate main protocol before primary freeze. No timing claim from bootstrap.

primary.name: Fresh construction plus query field multiplications
primary.definition: Per arm execute descriptor/full-fiber certification, necessary point-table lifting/hash build, then query. All primitive multiplications, including inverse/sqrt internals; memory/hash/sort unpriced. Candidate finite queries do not build an unused point table. Source row.work equals construction_work+query_work.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Length and SHA-256 of sorted complete pair set, compared across arms and replayed by wide scalar subtraction.

secondary.name: Stage wall interval
secondary.definition: Diagnostic elapsed interval covers each fresh construction and query, also recorded separately; external fixture creation/draw/scalar verifier excluded and recorded. BelowL2, wall_valid=false, no timing comparison.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: 6 configurations*5 arms*(0 warmups+2 retained)=60 planned calls.30s and4e9 multiplications per construction/query context;65536 root split attempts. Per-configuration cap300s preflight/600s main. Overall cap900s. All failed/missing calls retained, no adaptive retry.
Complete-set mismatch or positive-control miss invalidates its input; do not select configurations based on improvement. Retain remaining arm outcomes.

decision_rule.text: Descriptive paired fresh construction-plus-query counts and separate query counts after complete-set checks/wide replay. Configurations/populations/identity separate; no timing, exponent, fastest or whole-DLP inference. Retain failures and missing rows.
decision_rule.statistic: Frozen native median/min/max/all values and median of exact matched-input ratios, successful pairs only with failed counts adjacent.
decision_rule.interval: Observed range, not a confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: newton/half, half/lookup at total-arithmetic and query-only scope; half/half-aa and lookup/lookup-fast are deterministic count controls.

inadmissible: Change frozen matrix, targets, limits, analysis or repeats after affected calls
Pool configurations/populations/identity or calibration with primary
Drop construction or price lookup setup as free
Claim time/exponent/fastest/end-to-end DLP from these generic arithmetic counts
Claim auxiliary-isogeny search costs from Mobius-Kummer fixtures
Promote producer checks to independent signed standing
Rerun old completed experiments or spend on cloud

literature.ref: FLINTv3.3.1 src/nmod_poly/hgcd.c and src/gr_poly/hgcd.c; src/cryptanalysis/isogeny_eval/poly.rs; ic_framework/prime_tower.rs
literature.claim: Standard recursive polynomial half reduction, counted multiplication and normalized Velu-map source assumptions. No novelty claim.
literature.verified_by: Producer primary/internal source read; KB MCP/wrapper unavailable.

invalidation_rules: Counted results require complete-set equality and separate-process replay.
All local wall values are diagnostic, wall_valid=false for L2 claims, even when the isolated runner reports no detected contention.
Retain failures, timeouts, missing rows and warmups; report their actual flow.

extensions.user_authorization: Explicit continued local/Git-only authorization, no cloud or S3 operations.
extensions.standard_panel_exception: Use existing word62/P224 component curves to attribute the algorithm change, no prime-group assertion for word62. Rational fixtures certify all fibers and have a different field subset; no cross-representation speed claim.
extensions.binary_custody: Immutable ignored local cache; exact Git sources/compiler/build/lockfile and binary SHA published; no remote binary-archive availability claim.
